name: Mettingen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Mettingen (three red figures on white).
history: Municipal flag of Mettingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Mettingen arms — three red figures on white
